$comment: Kiln's install for this frame, as data. `device`: what the engine's USB-debugging flow reads (kiln-core UsbFrame): its names and its APK's release line. Format: docs/design/kiln/frames-as-data.md. A draft (#621): the contract (kiln/apps/kiln/test/contract) reads route, touch and each step's id, writes, reboots, downloads and taps; the engine reads the rest from phase 2.

releases.why: Glassworks for generic Android (Android 8+): docs/releasing.md; one APK per frame.json abi, as generic-release.yml names them
Its legacy build, for Android 6 and 7

needs.why: the release's APK is Glassworks for generic Android (API 26+); a picked file may be its legacy build (API 23+)

off.title: Kiln doesn't install on Android devices yet.

grants.why: What the generic app does with each (read in its code, 2026-11-18): secure settings let the Bluetooth proxy turn Location on; the device admin is what turns the screen off when idle (lockNow)

screenLock.line: This tablet has a PIN, pattern or password. When the screen turns off, someone has to unlock it. Glassworks keeps the screen on until you pick a time in its Screen settings. Before you do, turn the lock off in Android's Settings → Security → Screen lock → None or Swipe.

apk.why: Glassworks for generic Android (Android 8+), never its legacy build, from Kiln's release route; arm64-v8a, the ABI of the Pixel Tablet and most tablets on 8+. The recipe refuses a device that can't run it before anything is written
